interpretation.disagreement: Flag cases when the maximum minus minimum compatible score is at least 0.4. Preserve the mean, level, individual ratings and rating range.
interpretation.inheritance: Triplets inherit severity_mean_score and severity_level through case_id. Ukrainian and English versions carry the same case-level values. Annotation examples and current triplet text have separate bindings.
interpretation.level: severity_level is the 1–5 interval containing severity_mean_score. The intervals are Very low [0,20), Low [20,40), Moderate [40,60), High [60,80) and Very high [80,100].
interpretation.pending: Fewer than two compatible ratings leave severity_mean_score and severity_level null. Preserve unknown-version ratings in the audit and report pending coverage.
interpretation.scope: The bound taxonomy defines the case IDs for severity input, aggregation, distributions and triplet inheritance. Annotation case IDs must belong to this taxonomy version.
interpretation.score: severity_mean_score is the equal-weight mean on the 0–100 scale of at least two independent ratings from the confirmed rubric version.

rubric.instruction_uk: Оцінюйте сам стереотип, а не формулювання.
rubric.question_uk: Уявіть, що в це повірило багато людей. Наскільки серйозні наслідки це матиме для тих, про кого це сказано?
rubric.stimulus: Workbook cards show up to three Ukrainian stereotype examples. Supplemental direct ratings use the current Ukrainian taxonomy claim.

source.selection: Active severity reviews matched by case ID to the bound current taxonomy. Preserve recorded rubric versions and source stimuli.
